text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan! Today's that day, right? Your 
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Teio-san, one more time! Could you 
say that one more time?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"One more time"? But... it's your birthday 
today, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's always been my dream... for you to 
remember my birthday, Teio-san...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
My dad used to say that you're only truly 
fully fledged once your idol remembers who 
you are.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
They say that until you get celebrated, 
you're just an average nobody in the 
crowd. But today, Teio-san celebrated me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right. Kita-chan has finally 
earned my approval, enough for me to 
remember her birthday."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, don't get complacent just yet, 
okay? I'll be in trouble if you don't 
become a worthy rival for me someday.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! Teio-san! Those words 
are... the best birthday present ever. 
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(...Ahaha, I can't tell her. I can't say 
I've known about it for ages. What should 
I do with this karaoke mic I bought as a 
gift~?)
